note: 141-acre City of Granite Falls park on Highway 67 across the road from the Minnesota River, a rustic-style park of granite outcroppings and native woods; granite picnic shelter, playground, camper cabin. --Claude
summary: City page read: operating May 1-October 31, 13 RV sites on 14x40 ft pads, 20/30/50 amp, dump, reservations via ResNexus; RV fee $30 (RV in tent sites $25, tent $15) but the page gives no year for the rates, so fees left as stored. Showers and water hookups not mentioned (derived values left). No phone stored; city hall 320-564-3011.
